name: Volumetric Cloud Raymarching
definition: A technique to render volumetric clouds by tracing a ray through a 3D density field, accumulating color based on density, light scattering, and transmittance.
summary: Volumetric Cloud Raymarching renders clouds by tracing rays through a 3D density field to accumulate color and transmittance, enabling soft self-shadowing and god rays unlike solid geometry methods.
